.check.protein.info

Source: R/internal_functions.protein.info.R
dot-check.protein.info.Rd

Validates a protein annotation table and aligns it to a set of protein IDs. The table is re-ordered to strictly follow the order of protein.ids: proteins absent from the annotation are filled with NA, while annotations of proteins absent from the counts are dropped. This guarantees that the protein.info slot stays row-by-row aligned with the counts tables at any moment.

.check.protein.info(
  protein.info,
  protein.ids,
  id.column = NULL,
  arg.name = "protein.info",
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

protein.info

A data.frame (or matrix) with one row per protein, or NULL.

protein.ids

String vector of the protein IDs to which the table must be aligned (usually the row names of the counts).

id.column

String indicating the name of the column of protein.info containing the protein IDs. If NULL (default) the row names are used; when the table has no explicit row names a column named prot.id is looked up.

arg.name

String used in the error/warning messages to refer to the table. Default: "protein.info".

verbose

Logical value indicating whether to print messages about the alignment. Default: TRUE.

Value

A data.frame with length(protein.ids) rows and protein.ids as row names, or NULL.
